name: Pasta Arrabbiata
steps: Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil and add half the salt. Measure the other ingredients and prepare the vegetables.
Warm oil over medium-low heat and cook sliced garlic and chilli flakes for 1 minute without browning. Add finely chopped tomato and half the salt and simmer for 18–20 minutes until thick.
Cook pasta for the packet time until tender with a slight bite. Reserve 200 ml pasta water before draining.
Add the cooked pasta or gnocchi to the sauce and toss gently over low heat for 1–2 minutes. Add a splash of cooking water if needed to make the sauce cling.
Turn off heat and add torn basil; add grated vegetarian hard cheese if listed.
Taste, divide among four bowls and serve hot. Choose cheese labelled suitable for vegetarians.
tips: Prepare and measure every component before heating the pan; serve promptly for the best texture.
notes: Quantities are for four adult portions. Cooking times are estimates; use the doneness checks in each step. Ingredient costs use sample rates and exclude unpriced items.
